name: service-cards
goal: Services use the Helpers card grid with only a class or service name and Used In links, preserving search and revision navigation on desktop, tablet and mobile

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Services must match the existing helper grid, showing the class or service name and Used In links only. Search and both navigation targets retain revision scope across three viewports.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog SSR coverage explicitly required service tables. The standardized card-grid browser matrix covered only components and helpers. Extended those existing cases to services and preserved consumer and revision navigation assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit 95a9c9cc fails at the card-count assertion across desktop, tablet and mobile. Regression record e989c1d8a17a561d8a2469b25a6becf0d957e62baeb26386844f3209761441b3 preserves the failure. Before screenshots show the service table.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reused the helper card and grid for services. Service rows use their owned class symbol or registered name, with up to three revision-scoped consumer links and page fallback. No new controls or styling.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tests pass at fix commit 8c15da72: three desktop/tablet/mobile browser cases and 35 focused unit tests. Record 2599535693a35634a2fce2b03aa0b4c8e3fac401de6b6f08e13cf5654563675b preserves green proof after red record d45aadf12118511be8e095c93d43b6e2dc284e37557a7cb140fa40169dfed2d3.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Final UI code 13838843 passes the full Reports check (157 files, 610 tests), three card/navigation viewports, three 1000-row responsiveness cases, root typecheck, audit and registry validation. Real catalog class/consumer navigation passes on immutable build 1df1218e09a9f26cb8ba652447a49cbcf82615f50cb8dd1124eb752edee9f1b1. Full root verification remains blocked: the unchanged main cd36c21c source-move ownership test reports entityMeasure/entityShown definition changes; the same failure was reproduced there. Root check was stopped after that known failure; later root layers remain unrun. No merge or deployment.
